entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaspard-Théodore-Ignace de la Fontaine was a Luxembourgish politician and jurist. He led the Orangist movement and was the first prime minister of Luxembourg, serving for four months, from 1 August 1848 until 6 December of the same year.
